a. andrews. 62 ficicil mass Alli y aid to c. B 23169.8B

bol. Alexanden of Doorille - formerly May, Alesanda who kept the deleters Home eir Was tunste had aning othsuservants. one Lovesa Rudd. who had been the propert, of his wife. Sallie Rudd - and one Wesley Williams who became the husbane of sceit deresa while in Lusielle. and they hack four cheldien. Tuo of which Mary sheet the lock cult. then to trolay ha and No has Rachael. ance Leuesa eue left esi Louille with capt. Rudo, an As alexande-an Nru ceth Mes Alescondu, When May. Pelescande went to Joralle in 18 69 n 3, Lousa & Wesla, Milliam, declenese goes at him, and remained vi Has kurglin . On the Boar St cholas plyu belien Lonsulte e Cenema. 2 mest Rachack Alexande the Mother of freusa, (Wester) Alliams itasterstar, uho deries to hear fem her ano ushes to tele her ane he husband le senet E
